_comment: M28.14 add_make_struct_node post-apply soak. Duplicates BP_BpxTestGraphNodesCalls into a scratch path and spawns a UK2Node_MakeStruct typed against /Script/CoreUObject.Vector onto the default EventGraph at a fixed position. FVector is engine-shipped and stable across UE versions; CanBeMade returns true (X/Y/Z are BlueprintVisible non-BlueprintReadOnly). The soak gate asserts md5 stability across 2 rounds, proving SeedGuidFromJoined(':graph:EventGraph:make_struct:/Script/CoreUObject.Vector:768,-48') + SeedPinGuidsForNode overrides UEdGraphNode::CreateNewGuid + UEdGraphPin::CreatePin's FGuid::NewGuid() calls inside FMakeStructPinManager::CreateVisiblePins. skip_inspect=true because MakeStruct surfaces inline in the .deep.md as a flat per-field pin table whose exact format isn't grep-friendly.
